# migadu_mailbox (Data Source)

Fetches information about a Migadu mailbox.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "migadu_mailbox" "example" {
  domain_name = "example.com"
  local_part  = "alice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) The domain this mailbox belongs to.
- `local_part` (String) The local part of the mailbox address.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The full mailbox address.
- `footer_active` (Boolean) Whether the email footer is active.
- `footer_html_body` (String) HTML footer body.
- `footer_plain_body` (String) Plain-text footer body.
- `is_internal` (Boolean) Whether the mailbox is internal.
- `may_access_imap` (Boolean) Whether IMAP access is allowed.
- `may_access_managesieve` (Boolean) Whether ManageSieve access is allowed.
- `may_access_pop3` (Boolean) Whether POP3 access is allowed.
- `may_receive` (Boolean) Whether the mailbox may receive.
- `may_send` (Boolean) Whether the mailbox may send.
- `name` (String) The display name of the mailbox.
- `password_recovery_email` (String) Email address used for password recovery.
- `recipient_denylist` (List of String) List of denied recipients.
- `sender_allowlist` (List of String) List of allowed senders.
- `sender_denylist` (List of String) List of denied senders.
- `spam_action` (String) Action to take on spam messages.
- `spam_aggressiveness` (String) Spam aggressiveness level.
- `wildcard_sender` (Boolean) Whether wildcard sender is enabled.
